title: 함께 노는 시간
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a male tenor vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing arpeggiated chords and a clean electric guitar with light chorus and delay. A fretless bass enters with melodic slides. The drums use a soft, compressed snare and a subtle kick. The track is in the key of C Major with a tempo of 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance uses a mix of chest voice and breathy head voice transitions. Strings enter in the second half of the verse with sustained legato pads. The production features high-fidelity clarity with moderate hall reverb on the vocals and piano.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[arpeggiated grand piano, clean electric guitar with chorus]

[Verse 1]
[male tenor vocals, breathy delivery]
이유가 필요 없는 사랑이 있다는 걸 알았어
처음엔 네 과거가 궁금했어 어떤 사람이었는지 [fretless bass enters with a slide]
하나하나 알아가는 게 사랑이라고 생각했으니까
[strings enter, sustained legato pads]
그런데 지금은 달라 네 이야기가 없어도 괜찮아
네 상처를 다 알 필요 없다는 걸 배웠어
말하고 싶지 않은 과거는 그대로 두어도 돼 [soft kick drum and compressed snare enter]
